groupings.title: macOS
groupings.description: Standard-driven macOS setup with macos-setup: declare your Mac once in a standard, then converge any machine to it — read-only audit, interactive decision report, idempotent pipeline with human checkpoints, every write verified; an optional agent-node profile for always-on, agent-driven Macs.

groupings.title: Terminal
groupings.description: A consistent terminal standard with tmux-setup: tmux config, an interactive fzf-driven session manager, and tmuxinator templates, pushed to one or many machines over SSH — idempotent, diff-confirmed, cross-platform (macOS / Ubuntu / OpenWrt).
